description: This file defines the class LuceneSearchEngine, a specialized search engine implementation within the SuiteCRM project, utilizing Lucene for searching indexed records. It includes methods for executing searches, caching results, and handling search hits with access control considerations.

classes.name: LuceneSearchEngine
classes.description: A search engine class that interfaces with a Lucene index to perform searches within the SuiteCRM system, with caching and access control features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the search engine with the Lucene index bean.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search with the given SearchQuery, returning SearchResults while measuring performance.

methods.name: runLucene
methods.description: Executes the Lucene query, using cache if valid, or performing a fresh search.

methods.name: validateCacheStructure
methods.description: Checks whether the cached search hits have the expected structure.

methods.name: newHit
methods.description: Runs a new search query on the Lucene index, filters results based on access permissions, and caches the result.

methods.name: parseHits
methods.description: Processes raw hits into structured search results, applying pagination.

methods.name: cacheQuery
methods.description: Stores search results in cache for future use.
